analysis_scope.Q1_lock_attribution: per phase, classify every accepted-and-unserved order into exactly one bucket: MUTABLE / PROTECTED / EXCLUDED_FROM_REPLAN / STATUS_NOT_IDLE_READY / CLOSED_VEHICLE / COMMITTED_ANCHOR / UNREPRESENTED. Buckets are derived from the saved public_view only (protected, replan_ids, vehicle status, committed_next, mutable_suffix).
analysis_scope.Q2_mask_granularity_census: per phase, count DISTINCT candidate plan identities (action_contract.plan_hash over the full fleet plan) reachable by legality-only enumeration (route_check), under four pre-declared policies: CURRENT(size-2, 4 heuristics, seed 0) / S1_ONLY / MIXED_1_2 / MIXED_1_2_3.
analysis_scope.Q3_timing: all 289 phases are the single frozen type POST_ADMISSION_PRE_REPAIR; any alternative capture point is therefore UNASSESSABLE from these artifacts. Only two artifact-based quantities are reported: (a) orders that were in the mutable pool at phase k-1 and are frozen at phase k; (b) a scope-only structural upper bound that is explicitly NOT a legal option.

analyzed_unit: the 289 saved natural phases: (arm, day, ordinal) with arm in {SAA, MYOPIC}
candidate_identity: action_contract.plan_hash(plans) of the reconstructed fleet plan; no evaluation
purpose: Attribute where accepted-but-unserved orders are locked out of the legal mask scope, and census whether alternative legal mask granularities would create distinct candidate plan identities on the SAME saved public states.
